title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
snippet: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Bitcoin Suisse to shift up to half of Swiss jobs abroad
snippet: The Swiss crypto financial services firm plans to move back-office functions to lower-cost international hubs as it expands its global wealth and asset management business, according to Finews.

title: Anchorage Digital adds institutional access to Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin
snippet: The US federally chartered crypto bank will allow institutional clients to hold, mint, redeem and stake Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin through its custody platform.

title: Bitcoin spikes toward $80K as US CPI data delivers new 22-year high in bond yields
snippet: Bitcoin briefly rebounded past $79,000 and US stocks turned green as US CPI inflation data met expectations.

title: Metaplanet cuts Series 10 stock pool by 41%, plans Hong Kong subsidiary
snippet: Metaplanet will cut 131.3 million potential shares and form a $1 million Hong Kong subsidiary for trading in Bitcoin, equities and credit products.

title: Bitcoin ETF outflows accelerate as investors pull $449M in three days
snippet: ARK 21Shares accounted for $164 million of Thursday’s Bitcoin ETF withdrawals, while Ether and Solana funds also recorded net outflows.

title: Bitcoin buyers wary of July sub-$58K floor amid onchain data ‘anomaly’
snippet: Bitcoin HODL waves data revealed an unusually muted reaction to Bitcoin’s drop below $58,000, raising questions over its status as a bear-market floor.

title: India launches tokenized bond pilot with $107M issued
snippet: SEBI said later phases of Demat 2.0 will introduce secondary trading and open the tokenized bonds to retail investors.

title: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC
snippet: Blockstream said it would work with law enforcement, exchanges and forensic specialists to recover the Bitcoin if the hackers do not return it.

title: Bitwise to put down Dogecoin ETF less than a year after launch
snippet: BWOW held about $688,000 in net assets as of Sept. 9. Trading is expected to end Oct. 14, with cash payouts to follow around Oct. 22.

title: Revised CLARITY Act targets ‘non-decentralized’ DeFi operators
snippet: The bill’s ethics section remained largely unchanged despite being one of the main points of contention ahead of a pivotal Senate vote.

title: Metaplanet equity backlash, SE Asia crypto funding doubles: Asia Express
snippet: Shareholders of Bitcoin treasury company Metaplanet are seething over equity allocations for insiders, while new figures cement Singapore’s role as the top Asian crypto hub.

title: ESMA warns growing crypto ties could amplify risks to traditional finance
snippet: The EU securities regulator flagged tokenized equities, DeFi exploits and prediction markets as areas where growing crypto ties could pose risks to the broader financial system.

title: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position
snippet: The amendment would require the UK Treasury to develop a strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities and digital financial infrastructure.

title: EU finance groups push to remove tokenized securities cap
snippet: European finance and tokenization groups say Brussels should remove limits on assets admitted to DLT infrastructure or set a 1.5 trillion euro baseline if a cap remains.
